prompts.name: 01-coastal-glass
prompts.title: 01 · Coastal glass
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high fidelity Socially mobile authentication design comparison board, landscape canvas, TWO complete upright flat 390x844 mobile screens side by side, OTP entry left and successful login right. Label the board clearly with its option number and short name. Reference image 1 is the overview of all 34 existing app screens, reference 2 is the actual coastal welcome screen, reference 3 is the currently implemented OTP component. They are brand/style references only. Maintain Socially's established visual design: pale blue #E4EDF5, milky white glass surfaces, muted navy #2C4864 buttons, dark ink #191E43, Cormorant-like editorial serif headings with Inter-like body type. Coastal scene with seated cloaked voyager on shore and a small sailboat should visually harmonize with references. Mobile usable spacing, readable text, six digits in one row. OTP content: 'Check your inbox.', 'Enter the six-digit code we sent to', 'crew@example.com', code partial '1 2 3 — — —', 'We’ll continue automatically', 'Change email', 'Resend in 24s'. Successful login content: 'You’re signed in', 'Welcome aboard.', 'Taking you to Socially…', 'Enter Socially'. Keep success elegant without confetti. Concept has automatic verify on sixth digit and automatic redirect; do not imply OTP is a wallet seed phrase. No extra app features. Show only design mockups, not code. Add a small bottom caption with proposed animation; images represent still frames, not actual animations. Closest evolution of the existing welcome design: full coastal backdrop with small Socially wordmark and icon near top, single large rounded frosted bottom card, six separate 14px rounded squares, active square fine navy outline. OTP mail-to-lock emblem above title. Right screen preserves same coastal backdrop with dim veil and familiar frosted bottom success sheet; lock-to-check emblem. Animation caption: 'Mail → lock → check · soft sheet rise'. Keep sophisticated low contrast glass, no excessive nesting.
